races.notes: Safest race of the four: incumbent Droba backed by the whole liberal opposition (SaS, PS, Demokrati, Team Bratislava); won 2022 with 63.6 %. Government coalition (Smer, Hlas, SNS) unites behind low-profile Gajarský (4.3 % in only poll) - in 2022 Smer+SNS candidate got 13.4 %. Krajčovičová (Právo na pravdu + SaNK) is the populist/anti-establishment option; Staruch is an ex-SaS independent splitting the liberal vote marginally. KDH and Hnutie Slovensko do not formally nominate anyone (not on Droba's nomination). Bookmakers price Droba at 1.01 everywhere. No AKO/JOJ24 BSK poll found (JOJ24 published AKO regional polls for TT, TN, NR, PSK, KSK). No withdrawals known as of 2026-10-20 (national withdrawals so far: Laššáková PSK, Lučanský ŽSK, Belousovová ŽSK). Turnout 2022 was combined-election turnout (38.60 %); 2017 standalone regional election 31.34 %.

No party formally nominates any mayoral candidate; no Smer/Hlas mayoral candidate, so where government-leaning voters go (likely Mičega?) is unknown - no source found on party endorsements. Birošová (withdrew in favour of Mičega in 2018 and 2022) stays in this time, splitting the opposition vote. No public poll found. Bookmakers: Forgáč 1.10-1.19, Mičega 4.0-6.0. Turnout 2022 37.0 %, 2018 42.03 %. Mičega's 27 % ceiling was vs. a popular incumbent; open-seat dynamics are different.

races.notes: Incumbent Fiabáne (48.06 % 2018, 45.53 % 2022) faces fragmented field of 7. Main challengers: Johanes (doctor, ŽSK councillor) and Cibulka (3rd in 2022 with 15.51 %). In 2022 the 2nd place Groma (Hlas+KDH, 19.01 %) - this time KDH backs Fiabáne and Hlas/Smer/SNS/Domov run joint council lists but NO mayoral candidate; no source found on whether they informally back Johanes. Republika (Milo) is the only party-nominated challenger. Odds drifted from Fiabáne 1.04 / Johanes 7.0 (12.8.) to 1.18-1.20 / 3.8-4.0 (mid-Oct) - tightening but Fiabáne clear favourite. No scientific poll found (komunalne-volby.sk runs a self-selected web vote - not usable). Turnout 2022 38.16 %, 2018 41.3 %.
